# Calcus AI — complete service catalogue

> Calcus AI (also written CalcusAi) is a Sri Lankan technology company (registered as Calcusai (Pvt) Ltd) with its head office in Maharagama. It builds AI-powered and traditional (non-AI) software for businesses and organisations across all of Sri Lanka: AI chatbots and voice assistants, business automation, websites, mobile apps, POS and business management systems, e-commerce, payment integrations, learning management systems, cloud hosting, cybersecurity and IoT — in Sinhala, Tamil and English.

- Website: https://calcus.ai/
- All services: https://calcus.ai/services/
- Packages: https://calcus.ai/packages/
- For teachers and tuition classes (teacher website, class management, Z-score grade analyser, subject AI in Sinhala/Tamil/English, from LKR 80,000): https://calcus.ai/packages/for-teachers/
- Contact / project enquiries: https://calcus.ai/#contact
- Company: Calcusai (Pvt) Ltd
- Head office: Calcus HQ, 21/2 Rajamahavihara Road, Maharagama, Sri Lanka
- Phone: +94 70 184 0527
- Serves: all 9 provinces and 25 districts of Sri Lanka, remotely and with on-site visits where agreed
- Languages: Sinhala, Tamil and English
- Builds both AI-powered and traditional non-AI systems, and only adds AI where it adds value
- Vision: To make modern technology and artificial intelligence accessible, affordable, and useful across Sri Lanka.
- Works with leading AI and cloud platforms: OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, xAI Grok, Meta Llama, DeepSeek, Hugging Face, ElevenLabs and AWS
- Flagship project: ApilageAI, Sri Lanka's first AI + human learning community, where learners ask questions, share answers, run polls and chat with AI — built and powered by Calcus AI

## Who it serves

Small and medium businesses, retail stores, restaurants, hotels, travel companies, schools, tuition institutes, universities, training centres, clinics, hospitals, agricultural businesses, factories, logistics providers, construction companies, property businesses, NGOs, government institutions, corporate enterprises, startups, developers, freelancers, and individual professionals.

## Areas served

Western Province (Colombo, Gampaha, Kalutara); Central Province (Kandy, Matale, Nuwara Eliya); Southern Province (Galle, Matara, Hambantota); Northern Province (Jaffna, Kilinochchi, Mannar, Vavuniya, Mullaitivu); Eastern Province (Batticaloa, Ampara, Trincomalee); North Western Province (Kurunegala, Puttalam); North Central Province (Anuradhapura, Polonnaruwa); Uva Province (Badulla, Monaragala); Sabaragamuwa Province (Ratnapura, Kegalle).

## Delivery options

1. Ready-to-Use Products: Standardized solutions that customers can subscribe to, configure, and begin using with minimal development.
2. Customized Solutions: Software, AI assistants, and automations built around an individual customer's requirements.
3. Enterprise & Institutional Solutions: Larger systems with advanced integrations, permissions, scalability, security, and dedicated support.
4. Managed Technology Services: Ongoing cloud hosting, software operations, AI monitoring, maintenance, and optimization.

## Why choose Calcus AI

- AI or Non-AI: We develop the right technology for the customer's needs, without requiring AI where it adds no value.
- Designed for Sri Lanka: Local business requirements, multilingual users, regional accessibility, and LKR payment options.
- One Technology Partner: Websites, applications, AI, hosting, integrations, deployment, and maintenance.
- Flexible Budgets: Starter, subscription-based, customized, and enterprise delivery models.
- Own Your Operations: Custom dashboards, user access controls, transparent integrations, and agreed data ownership terms.
- Built to Grow: Systems can start small and expand with the organization.
- Human Support: Technical assistance, onboarding, training, and continued maintenance.
- Responsible Technology: Privacy, security, consent, transparency, and human oversight are part of solution planning.
